tactical_move: Delivering the sealed demand to force the commission's formal involvement in the burning
state_change_precondition: The commission has not yet received any demand or notice of the burning
state_change: The sealed letter is placed in the clerk's hands at the commission chambers
forces_choice: forces the PC to choose between presenting evidence at the convened hearing or directing a proxy to speak
branch_a: Attend the hearing in person to name the profiteers directly
branch_b: Dispatch a trusted proxy to the hearing while pursuing independent leads on the fire
scene_purpose: Trigger the commission's receipt of the demand and open the path to investigation
forward_pressure: The commission will now convene and issue summonses

introduces.label: Toll Road Commission
introduces.justification: Player action names and addresses this body to demand action
introduces.future_relevance: Will investigate the burning and summon those who profited

derivation: Player's explicit action of sending sealed word to the commission that governs the toll road directly requires adopting the body as canon so the demand can be received and acted upon

event_slots.precondition: A messenger carrying the sealed letter must reach the commission chambers
event_slots.exit_state: the commission has received the demand for an investigation into the burning
